create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor module to scale PyTorch tensor outputs by a learned factor
fit_ScaleFactor_variance_ratio: fit a ScaleFactor by computing the variance ratio between input and output tensors
observe_ScaleFactor_gradients: observe tensor statistics during forward pass to collect variance data for fitting
set_ScaleFactor_value: set the scale factor value directly on a fitted or unfitted ScaleFactor module
reset_ScaleFactor_parameters: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale factor parameter
